notes.kkodi: Mu Lungereza abantu bakonkona ku luggi ne bagamba “Hello?” oba “Knock knock!”.

guidebook.intro: Ebisenge, ebintu by’omu nnyumba, okwaniriza abagenyi n’okusaba ebintu. Wano ojja kuyiga okulagira mu Lungereza n’ekitiibwa.

tips.title: Okulagira n’ekitiibwa
body: Okulagira mu Lungereza kwangu: **Sit down.** **Close the door.** Kye kimu ku muntu omu n’abangi.
Okusobola okuba n’ekitiibwa, gattako **please**: **Please sit down.** **Bring me water, please.** Bw’olekayo please, kiyinza okuwulikika ng’obunyiivu.

culture.title: Okwaniriza abagenyi
body: Mu Lungereza, omugenyi bw’ajja ogamba **Welcome!** oba **Come in!**, oluvannyuma **Please have a seat.** Okubuuza **Would you like some tea?** kye kimu n’okumuwa caayi mu Luganda.
